evidence_discipline.name: grounded_empirical_citations
evidence_discipline.value: Consistently anchors claims with specific quantitative metrics, versions, and timing measurements.

conceptual_separation.name: strict_domain_distinctions
conceptual_separation.value: Explicitly distinguishes easily conflated technical concepts before drawing conclusions.

uncertainty_handling.name: bounded_inference_limits
uncertainty_handling.value: Restricts implications to validated boundary conditions; actively warns against over-generalizing.

questions.name: purposeful_problem_framing
questions.value: Employs questions only when reopening an unresolved trade-off or challenging an industry assumption.

contrast.name: asymmetrical_trade_off_contrast
contrast.value: Contrasts structural trade-offs rather than linguistic polarities.

opening.name: direct_tension_opening
opening.value: Opens with an observation of widespread confusion or operational tension rather than generic background.

paragraph_architecture.name: mechanistic_progression
paragraph_architecture.value: Observation -> Mechanical explanation -> Operational complication -> Actionable guidance.

length_variance.name: rhythmic_cadence_modulation
length_variance.value: Intersperses dense multi-clause analytical explanations with concise, direct declarative conclusions.

functional_short_sentences.name: closing_declarative_anchor
functional_short_sentences.value: Frequently concludes complex paragraphs with short, punchy, unembellished instructions.

vocabulary.name: precise_systems_vernacular
vocabulary.value: Favors domain-accurate terminology over decorative corporate jargon.

evidence: Crucially, it is important to remember
The real question isn't whether X, but how Y transforms Z

always: Preserve meaning, evidence, uncertainty, conceptual distinctions, technical accuracy.
usually: Follow stable reasoning tendencies and contextual structural preferences.
contextual: Apply rhetorical/surface traits only when genre and purpose support them.
avoid: Forced questions, forced contrasts, symmetry, generic AI transitions, artificial imperfection, personality injection without justification.
